_comment: Recorded from a live Kimi k3 (api.kimi.com/coding/v1, OpenAI Chat Completions) with stream_options.include_usage set. Pins the usage relay: the upstream sends a trailing choices-less chunk carrying usage, and the gateway must pass it on to the client before [DONE]. It used to be decoded, accumulated for billing, and then dropped, so anything downstream that meters saw nothing.
